Transaction-TransactionEntry Join.query:
SELECT TOP 5 
                    t.TransactionNumber,
                    t.Time,
                    t.Total,
                    te.ItemID,
                    te.Price,
                    te.Quantity
                FROM [dbo].[Transaction] t
                JOIN dbo.TransactionEntry te ON t.TransactionNumber = te.TransactionNumber
                ORDER BY t.Time DESC

Item-Category Join.query:
SELECT TOP 5
                    i.Description as ItemName,
                    i.Price,
                    i.Cost,
                    c.Name as CategoryName
                FROM dbo.Item i
                LEFT JOIN dbo.Category c ON i.CategoryID = c.ID
                WHERE i.Quantity > 0
                ORDER BY i.Price DESC

Transaction-Item-Category Join.query:
SELECT TOP 5
                    t.Time,
                    i.Description,
                    c.Name as Category,
                    te.Price,
                    te.Quantity,
                    (te.Price * te.Quantity) as Revenue
                FROM [dbo].[Transaction] t
                JOIN dbo.TransactionEntry te ON t.TransactionNumber = te.TransactionNumber
                JOIN dbo.Item i ON te.ItemID = i.ID
                LEFT JOIN dbo.Category c ON i.CategoryID = c.ID
                WHERE t.Time >= DATEADD(day, -7, GETDATE())
                ORDER BY Revenue DESC
Transaction-Item-Category Join.description: Full sales data with categories (last 7 days)
